name: Ouka Rouman
source:
It's rise of exorcists, cults and assassins. Allen and his friends chase the black order and capture its general. General confesses that he dropped anti-akuma weapon "Innocence" somewhere in Japan, so friends start their search in Japan anew.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
驱魔师、邪教与刺客纷纷崛起。亚连与伙伴们追寻黑色教团的踪迹，并抓住了一位元帅。元帅坦言，自己将对抗恶魔的武器“圣洁”遗落在日本的某个地方，于是伙伴们再次在日本展开搜寻。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]］
